verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Helicone instruments apps by routing traffic through its AI Gateway using the third-party OpenAI SDK, with "one-line" integrations for OpenAI, LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK. Nothing in the pack documents Helicone's own officially supported SDKs for Python or for JS/TS. Reusing other vendors' SDKs through a proxy is an adjacent integration path, not first-party SDKs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs
